targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "temperature_c")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "humidity_pct")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "wind_speed_kmh")
from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r._field == "rain_mm")

from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "iot_reading" and r.message_type == "WXOBS" and (r._field == "temperature_c" or r._field == "humidity_pct" or r._field == "pressure_hpa")) |> last() |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> keep(columns: ["_time", "device_id", "temperature_c", "humidity_pct", "pressure_hpa"])
